Why choose Soul Horse Hoofcare LLC?

Our Mission— The goal every time I pick up a hoof is to leave the horse better off than I found him, and balance preventative measures with comfort so that your “soul horse” (or soul horses) can feel their best and will have the necessary hoofcare to help prevent long term issues so that they’ll stay with you for as long as possible— because I know there’s nothing like the bond between a person and their horse or the peace horses bring the soul.

Soul Horse Hoofcare LLC is interested in providing whole-horse and horse-first hoofcare. The hooves affect the rest of the body and the rest of the body affects the hooves. It’s often said, “No hoof, no horse,” which is true, but the inverse is also true; a horse who is unsupported in the rest of their needs will never have their best hooves, either. I’m interested in bringing your horse the best hoofcare I can offer, but I’m also interested in helping you find resources to help support his body, nutrition, movement, and comfort— because the hoof is inseparable from the rest of the horse.

The values of this business include

\- HOLISM (without disregard for veterinary science; I believe veterinary science is part of holism, not separate from it),

\- COMPASSION for both animals and owners,

\- RELIABILITY so you can know you can count on your hoofcare provider to show up when they say they’re going to,

\- MUTUAL TRANSPARENCY about concerns relating to your horse and/or their hoofcare

\- SUPPORT & COMMUNITY because no one should feel alone in making important decisions for their horse, and vets, bodyworkers, and hoofcare providers should be a team with the owner,

\- EDUCATION, for me and for you! I’m happy to answer any questions or concerns you have in depth, and every payment for hoofcare services isn’t just for the services— it’s an investment that allows me to continue my education and make sure I never stop improving for your horse, and last but not least,

\- THE HORSE AS A PRIORITY; the horse’s welfare will always be my primary concern. If your horse doesn’t like what’s being done, it doesn’t matter what I or anyone else was taught; if it isn’t working for the horse, it’s wrong, and I want to know what your horse thinks.

If you’re looking for reliable, compassionate whole-horse hoofcare, reach out to me by call or text at or to set up an appointment. I service the northeast Alabama and northwest Georgia areas and I offer horse, donkey, mule, goat and sheep hoofcare.

This business is owned and services provided by Lily Pike of Draketown, Georgia, a trimmer certified through Ida Hammer’s Mackinaw Dells 2 program.
